```{r}
#General utility packages
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

# read nifti
library(oro.nifti)

library(effectsize)

#Plot pacakges
library(wesanderson)
pal <- wes_palette("Zissou1", 100, type = "continuous")

```

```{r}


# read the roi and atlas file. 
roi.list<-read.csv2('assets/script/Regions_IDs_split.csv',sep=';')

design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv') %>% rename(animal_ID = `Animal ID`) %>% mutate(animal_ID=as.character(animal_ID))
img <- readNIfTI('assets/nifti/pre/heatmaps_rs_smooth.nii.gz')
atlas_img<-readNIfTI('assets/script/rs_atlas_split.nii.gz')
mask_img <- readNIfTI('assets/nifti/pre/mask_corr.nii.gz')
orig_raw<-read_csv('assets/orig_Marloes/pre_raw.csv')
cluster<-read_csv('assets/script/roi_cluster.csv')

contrast_img_heat<-mask_img
contrast_img_raw<-mask_img

contrast_img_heat[which(contrast_img_heat[,,]!=0)]<-0
contrast_img_raw[which(contrast_img_raw[,,]!=0)]<-0

atlas_img<-atlas_img*mask_img

df <- data.frame(name=character(),
                nvox=double(),
                 g_raw=double(),
                 g_heat=double(),
                 g_dif=double(),
                 lower=double(), 
                 upper=double(),
                 stringsAsFactors=FALSE) 
ii<-1

cluster_unique<-unique(cluster$Region)

for(i in 1:length(cluster_unique)){
  name<-cluster_unique[i]
  ID_list<-cluster$ID[cluster$Region==name]
  name_list<-roi.list$name[roi.list$id %in% ID_list]
  selectROI<-which(atlas_img[,,] %in% ID_list)
    #if not empty list of voxels, get the sum for each mouse
  if(length(selectROI)>0){
    print(name)
    tmp_sumlist<-c()
    for(j in 1:dim(img)[4]){
      tmp<-img[,,,j]
      tmp_sumlist[j]<-sum(tmp[selectROI])
      }
    if(sum(tmp_sumlist==0)==length(tmp_sumlist)){next}
    g <- hedges_g(tmp_sumlist~ design$Group)
    df[ii,'name']<-name
    df[ii,'g_heat']<-g$Hedges_g
    df[ii,'lower']<-g$CI_low
    df[ii,'upper']<-g$CI_high
    df[ii,'nvox']<-length(selectROI)
    
    
    
    orig_tmp<-orig_raw %>%  filter(grepl(paste(name_list, collapse="|"), name)) %>% select(-id, -name, -structure_order, -parent_id) %>% summarise_all(sum)%>% pivot_longer(cols=everything(), names_to='animal_ID', values_to='ncell')
    
    if(sum(orig_tmp$ncell==0)==dim(orig_tmp)[1]){ii<-ii+1; next}
    merge_tmp<-full_join(design,orig_tmp, by = "animal_ID") 
    df[ii,'g_raw']<-hedges_g(merge_tmp$ncell~merge_tmp$Group)$Hedges_g
    df[ii,'g_dif']<-abs(hedges_g(merge_tmp$ncell~merge_tmp$Group)$Hedges_g - g$Hedges_g)
    
    contrast_img_heat[selectROI]<-g$Hedges_g
    contrast_img_raw[selectROI]<-hedges_g(merge_tmp$ncell~merge_tmp$Group)$Hedges_g
    
     ii<-ii+1
    
  }  
}




df %>% write_csv('assets/script/pre_roi_cluster.csv') 
writeNIfTI(contrast_img_heat,'assets/script/pre_g_cluster_heat')
writeNIfTI(contrast_img_raw,'assets/script/pre_g_cluster_raw')

```
